ASPECT TO VERIFY

ASPECT TO VERIFY:
Yes/No/NA
REMARK/DETAILS

1. Audit notification and assignment of auditor sign prior to audit.

2. The audit plan was sent to the client on time and audit conducted as per plan.

3.The lead auditor (and technical expert) is qualified as per F 9.17

4. Auditor/ Industrial declaration for no conflict of interest has been signed prior to audit.

5. Opening and closing meeting done as per scheduled time and prompter covered.

6. The audit report covered all the formats applicable as per audit binder.

7. Key processes identified and sample covered adequately. Assessment covered the standards requirements as per checkpoint provided in the audit details sheet F 7.26 and its Annexture/s as per the applicable standard/s.

8. Action taken on the Issue/ Areas of concern raise if any during Last periodical audit are verified.

9. If major NC/s, the evidence/s attached for verification and auditor has reviewed, accepted the evidences for correction and corrective actions.

10. If minor NC/s, the auditor has reviewed and accepted the client’s plan for correction and corrective actions.

11. Audit summery and recommendation of audit result clearly addressed.

12. Frequency of surveillance required is decided by lead auditor.

13. Was objectives of the audit have been achieved.

14. Information provided by client in audit application is confirmed by auditor. (Applicable to Initial certification/Re-certification)

15. The effectiveness of correction and corrective action taken by client is verified by auditor for the NC raised during last audit. (Surveillance and Recertification )

16. All the activities covered in the scope have verified by auditor and in the event if any change in scope from existing, the changes has been audited and details provided by auditor.

17. Does performance of certified client management system verified and the original certification decision can continue? ( Surveillance Audit/ Recertification)

18.Contracts have been signed prior to audits. (Applicable to Re-certification/ Transfer audit)

All the audit process of audit and audit report has been verified, The information and evidences provided in the audit report are sufficient for recommendation made by auditor and acceptable to AITF.

CONTROL FORMAT -1
CONFLICT OF INTERESTS& IMPARTIALITY
CONFLICT OF INTERESTS& IMPARTIALITY

1. Was AITF's top management related to the consultancy organization of the client?
2. Did AITF's auditor or individual involved in certification process have any affiliations with the client's consulting organizations?
3. Whether auditor or individual involved in certification process was related to the consulting organisation of the client?
TRAINING, INTERNAL AUDITS & OTHER SERVICES
4. Did AITF provide any training services to the client?
5. Did AITF provide any internal audit services to the client?
6. Did AITF provide supplier assessment services to the client?
7. Did AITF offer any services other than registration to the client?
8. Did AITF link the success of the client's audit to the amount of salary/bonus paid to the auditors?
9. Did AITF provide its auditing activity to the clients consulting organisation's employee or any managerial position?
10. Is there any information or evidence of acceptance of rewards, incentives, bribes, presents etc., from the client?
AUDITOR SELECTION/ALLOCATION
11. Was the selection of auditor done as per the scope of certification of the client?
12. Did the audit team have adequate technical knowledge and expertise on the processes and geographical area of the client?
13. Has the auditor been an ex- employee/ part of the management of the client organization?
14. Has the auditor signed declaration statement on Impartiality & Confidentiality?
15. Whether same team leader was appointed for last two consequence audits?
CERTIFICATION DECISION
16. Was the audit carried out as per the defined criteria by AITF and contents of audit report are adequate for certification decision?
17. Has any audit team member is been a part of AITF's team for certification decision?
18. Did the group or individual that took the decision on granting of certification understand the applicable standard, certification requirements, and competent to evaluate the audit processes and related recommendations of the audit?
19. Were there any potential sources of conflict of interests identified in connection with the certification of the client, either from within AITF or from the activities of other persons, bodies?

CONTROL POINT-2
Certification Decision Committee (CDC)
CONSULTANCY
1. Was there any evidence or information to indicate that AITF-MCL has offered or provided consultancy services to the client?
OTHER SERVICES
2. Did AITF offer any services other than certification services to the client?
AUDITOR ALLOCATION
3. Has the auditor signed AITF's policy statement on Confidentiality & Conflict of Interest?
4.Has the auditor signed AITF's Confidentiality & Impartiality Undertaking F 11.03
CERTIFICATION DECISION
5. Did the group or individual that took the decision on granting certification understand the applicable standard and certification requirements, and demonstrated competence to evaluate the audit processes and related recommendations of the audit team?
6. Has there been any inference to personnel, either internal or external, or committees, who could influence the certification activities, did not act impartially and/or allowed commercial, financial or other pressures to compromise impartiality?
7.Was/is there any link between the certified client and any member of the Certification decision committee?
